answer: A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the horizon graph. Re-attestations are stored in jetty and mirror lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 15 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 1041 impostors cost 1815 times the honest price and take 25 times as long to clear. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
